descriptions.d24i_hud_text_start_8011ae58: Start a HUD text element: calls its virtual +52, resolves its text object (+28, 0x80343580) and applies a stack style record through the text's virtual +84 (scale 5.0f on three axes, white colour, opaque black shadow, flag 0); then calls 0x8011adf8 with the small-data settings 0x804af3b0 and 0x804af3b4, its virtual +48 with state 2, and subscribes to the cached message 0x804af3a8 with slot +48.
